title: ciliaria aspera
intro: Ciliaria aspera, commonly known as Velvet Bean or Cowitch, is a perennial vine native to tropical regions of Asia and Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Ciliaria aspera include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Ciliaria aspera include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-allergic, and antipyretic properties.
